⭐ `skipped` counts as reporting — the defect #16482 fixed was an **absence** of check runs (permanently pending), not a failing one.

⚠️ Held until every check settled: at t+150s the reading was 5 of 6, because the `TypeScript Type Check` aggregate publishes only after its four legs finish. A partial check list is not a reading.

⚠️ **Correction to my comment above: I said "both probe branches are being deleted". I could not delete them, and they are still on the remote.**

Measured, both routes:

```
DELETE /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/git/refs/heads/claude/probe-16482-head   -> HTTP 403
DELETE /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/git/refs/heads/claude/probe-16482-base   -> HTTP 403
  {"message":"Write access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy."}

git push origin --delete <branch>   -> send-pack: unexpected disconnect ... "Everything up-to-date"
```

⇒ ⛔ **Not a repository permission** — this session's egress proxy refuses ref deletion outright, by either channel. `git ls-remote --heads origin 'claude/probe-16482*'` still returns **2**.

**What remains, and it is inert:**

- `claude/probe-16482-base` @ `a4f76f56a6` — one file, `.probe-16482-base.md`
- `claude/probe-16482-head` @ `fa2b3090b2` — that plus `.probe-16482-head.md`

Neither is on `main`, neither has an open PR (this one is closed), and neither touches a product path. They cost nothing but a listing entry.

**Ask:** whoever has branch-delete access, please remove both. ⛔ Nothing depends on them and nothing should be merged from them.

⭐ Recorded as a platform reading for this seat as well: **this container can create branches and PRs but cannot delete a remote ref.** ⇒ a throwaway branch is not actually disposable here, and any future probe of this shape should be weighed knowing the cleanup cannot be finished from inside the session. I would still have taken this reading — #16482's row 1 had no other route and no natural specimen existed — but the cost was one branch pair more permanent than I claimed.
